schema.title: Bundle
schema.description: A container for a collection of resources.

identifier.description: A persistent identifier for the bundle that will not change as a bundle is copied from server to server.

type.description: Indicates the purpose of this bundle - how it is intended to be used.

timestamp.description: The date/time that the bundle was assembled.

total.description: If a set of search matches, this is the (potentially estimated) total number of entries of type "match" across all pages in the search.

link.description: A series of links that provide context to this bundle.

items.description: An entry in a bundle resource - will either contain a resource or information about a resource (transactions and history only).

entry.description: An entry in a bundle resource.

signature.description: Digital Signature - base64 encoded. XML-DSig or a JWT.

schema.title: Patient
schema.description: Demographics and other administrative information about an individual or animal receiving care or other health-related services.

implicitRules.description: A set of rules under which this content was created.

active.description: Whether this patient record is in active use.

address.description: An address for the individual. Patient may have multiple addresses with different uses or applicable periods.

birthDate.description: The date of birth for the individual.

communication.description: A language which may be used to communicate with the patient about his or her health.

contact.description: A contact party (e.g. guardian, partner, friend) for the patient.

deceasedBoolean.description: Indicates if the individual is deceased or not.

deceasedDateTime.description: Indicates if the individual is deceased or not.

gender.description: Administrative gender - the gender that the patient is considered to have.

generalPractitioner.description: Patient's nominated care provider. May be a primary care provider, a patient nominated care manager, or organization.

identifier.description: An identifier for this patient.

link.description: Link to another patient resource that concerns the same actual patient.

managingOrganization.description: Organization that is the custodian of the patient record. There is only one managing organization for a specific patient record.

maritalStatus.description: This field contains a patient's most recent marital (civil) status.

multipleBirthBoolean.description: Indicates whether the patient is part of a multiple (boolean) birth.

multipleBirthInteger.description: Indicates the actual birth order when the patient is part of a multiple birth.

name.description: A name associated with the individual. A patient may have multiple names with different uses or applicable periods.

telecom.description: A contact detail (e.g. a telephone number or an email address) by which the individual may be contacted.

schema.title: Binary
schema.description: A resource that represents the data of a single raw artifact as digital content accessible in its native format. A Binary resource can contain any content, whether text, image, pdf, zip archive, etc.

implicitRules.description: A set of rules under which this content was created.

contentType.description: MimeType of the binary content represented as a standard MimeType (BCP 13).

data.description: The actual content, base64 encoded. If the content type is itself base64 encoding, then this will be base64 encoded twice.

securityContext.description: A reference to a resource that provides guides, context or identifies the access rules that should be applied to the binary.

schema.title: Observation
schema.description: Measurements and simple assertions made about a patient, device or other subject.

implicitRules.description: A set of rules under which this content was created.

basedOn.description: A plan, proposal or order that is fulfilled in whole or in part by this event.

bodySite.description: Indicates the site on the subject's body where the observation was made.

category.description: A code that classifies the general type of observation being made.

code.description: Describes what was observed. Sometimes this is called the observation 'name'.

component.description: Some observations have multiple component observations. These component observations are expressed as separate code value pairs that share the same attributes.

dataAbsentReason.description: Provides a reason why the expected value in the element Observation.value[x] is missing.

derivedFrom.description: The target resource that represents a measurement from which this observation value is derived.

device.description: The device used to generate the observation data.

effectiveDateTime.description: The time or time-period the observed value is asserted as being true. At least a date should be present unless this observation is a historical report.

encounter.description: The healthcare event (e.g. a patient and healthcare provider interaction) during which this observation is made.

focus.description: The actual focus of an observation when it is not the patient of record representing something or someone associated with the patient such as a spouse, parent, fetus, or donor.

hasMember.description: This observation is a group observation (e.g. a battery, a panel of tests, a set of vital sign measurements) that includes the target as a member of the group.

identifier.description: A unique identifier assigned to this observation.

interpretation.description: A categorical assessment of an observation value.

issued.description: The date and time this version of the observation was made available to providers, typically after the results have been reviewed and verified.

method.description: Indicates the mechanism used to perform the observation.

note.description: Comments about the observation or the results.

partOf.description: A larger event of which this particular Observation is a component or step.

performer.description: Who was responsible for asserting the observed value as "true".

referenceRange.description: Guidance on how to interpret the value by comparison to a normal or recommended range.

specimen.description: The specimen that was used when this observation was made.

status.description: The status of the result value.

subject.description: The patient, or group of patients, location, or device this observation is about and into whose or what record the observation is placed.

valueQuantity.description: The information determined as a result of making the observation, if the information has a simple value.

schema.description: Measurements and simple assertions made about a patient, device or other subject.

implicitRules.description: A set of rules under which this content was created.

basedOn.description: A plan, proposal or order that is fulfilled in whole or in part by this event.

bodySite.description: Indicates the site on the subject's body where the observation was made.

category.description: A code that classifies the general type of observation being made.

code.description: Describes what was observed. Sometimes this is called the observation 'name'.

component.description: Some observations have multiple component observations. These component observations are expressed as separate code value pairs that share the same attributes.

dataAbsentReason.description: Provides a reason why the expected value in the element Observation.value[x] is missing.

derivedFrom.description: The target resource that represents a measurement from which this observation value is derived.

device.description: The device used to generate the observation data.

effectiveDateTime.description: The time or time-period the observed value is asserted as being true. At least a date should be present unless this observation is a historical report.

encounter.description: The healthcare event (e.g. a patient and healthcare provider interaction) during which this observation is made.

focus.description: The actual focus of an observation when it is not the patient of record representing something or someone associated with the patient such as a spouse, parent, fetus, or donor.

hasMember.description: This observation is a group observation (e.g. a battery, a panel of tests, a set of vital sign measurements) that includes the target as a member of the group.

identifier.description: A unique identifier assigned to this observation.

interpretation.description: A categorical assessment of an observation value.

issued.description: The date and time this version of the observation was made available to providers, typically after the results have been reviewed and verified.

method.description: Indicates the mechanism used to perform the observation.

note.description: Comments about the observation or the results.

partOf.description: A larger event of which this particular Observation is a component or step.

performer.description: Who was responsible for asserting the observed value as "true".

referenceRange.description: Guidance on how to interpret the value by comparison to a normal or recommended range.

specimen.description: The specimen that was used when this observation was made.

status.description: The status of the result value.

subject.description: The patient, or group of patients, location, or device this observation is about and into whose or what record the observation is placed.

valueQuantity.description: The information determined as a result of making the observation, if the information has a simple value.

schema.title: DiagnosticReport
schema.description: The findings and interpretation of diagnostic tests performed on patients, groups of patients, devices, and locations, and/or specimens derived from these.

implicitRules.description: A set of rules under which this content was created.

identifier.description: Identifiers assigned to this report by the performer or other systems.

status.description: The status of the diagnostic report.

category.description: A code that classifies the clinical discipline, department or diagnostic service that created the report.

code.description: A code or name that describes this diagnostic report.

subject.description: The subject of the report. Usually, but not always, this is a patient.

encounter.description: The healthcare event which this DiagnosticReport is about.

effectiveDateTime.description: The time or time-period the observed values are related to. When the subject of the report is a patient, this is usually either the time of the procedure or of specimen collection(s).

issued.description: The date and time that this version of the report was made available to providers, typically after the report was reviewed and verified.

performer.description: The diagnostic service that is responsible for issuing the report.

resultsInterpreter.description: The practitioner or organization that is responsible for the report's conclusions and interpretations.

specimen.description: Details about the specimens on which this diagnostic report is based.

result.description: Observations that are part of this diagnostic report.

imagingStudy.description: One or more links to full details of any imaging performed during the diagnostic investigation.

media.description: A list of key images associated with this report.

conclusion.description: Concise and clinically contextualized summary conclusion of the report.

conclusionCode.description: One or more codes that represent the summary conclusion of the report.

presentedForm.description: Rich text representation of the entire result as issued by the diagnostic service.

schema.title: Practitioner
schema.description: A person who is directly or indirectly involved in the provisioning of healthcare.

implicitRules.description: A set of rules under which this content was created.

identifier.description: An identifier that applies to this person in this role.

active.description: Whether this practitioner's record is in active use.

name.description: The name(s) associated with the practitioner.

telecom.description: A contact detail for the practitioner, e.g. a telephone number or an email address.

address.description: Address(es) of the practitioner that are not role specific (typically home address).

gender.description: Administrative Gender — the gender that the person is considered to have for administration and record keeping purposes.

birthDate.description: The date of birth for the practitioner.

qualification.description: The official certifications, training, and licenses that authorize or otherwise pertain to the provision of care by the practitioner.

communication.description: A language the practitioner can use in patient communication.

FhirDateSearch.description: A FHIR R4 date search value (§ search.html#date): an optional comparison prefix (eq/ne/gt/lt/ge/le/sa/eb/ap) in front of a date or dateTime of any precision, e.g. ge2026, 2026-07, or lt2026-07-27T14:27:30Z. The value denotes the period its precision implies. See slices/emr/fhir-r4/docs/Client Capabilities Reference.md.
